value.title: Standing Out in a Town Full of Great Businesses
value.description:
Montclair has several busy business districts: downtown along Bloomfield Avenue and Church Street, Walnut Street, Watchung Plaza, and Upper Montclair. Each one has its own crowd, and its own competition. A sign out front isn't enough when the restaurant next door has hundreds of reviews and posts every day.

We help Montclair businesses win the search, the scroll, and the second look, with marketing tuned to the neighborhood you're in and the customers you want.

faqs.question: Do you have indoor billboard screens in Montclair?
faqs.answer: Our screen network currently runs in venues in neighboring Bloomfield and West Orange, just minutes from downtown Montclair and visited by plenty of Montclair residents. We're always adding venues, so if your Montclair business has steady foot traffic, consider becoming a venue partner.

faqs.question: Which marketing should a Montclair restaurant start with?
faqs.answer: Start with your Google Business Profile, since it's where most diners decide. Then add social media to keep regulars coming back, and social ads when you want to fill slower nights.

faqs.question: Can you target specific Montclair neighborhoods?
faqs.answer: Yes. Social media ads and geofencing can focus on specific areas like Upper Montclair or the downtown district, so your budget goes toward the customers most likely to visit.
